payload.body:
Guild listing: Vanguard. Published by Phoenix Collective (Falkor's team) from the guild's own public text (shortened, verbatim excerpts; full text in ORIGINALS.md), supplied by the Founder.

"Lead Boldly. Thrive Together."

Vanguard is a premier military contractor operating at the heart of the MUD defense industry in Star Atlas. Our mission is simple: empower your success — whether on the battlefield, in deep space, or behind the front lines.

Munitions & Weapon-Grade Materials

Bounty Hunting & Target Elimination

Security, Defense Operations, & Strategic Freight Transport

Our personnel are seasoned, precise, and committed to excellence.

https://discord.gg/h6t3Z7NNrF
